description: The complete verb surface. Five names. C-ABSENCE.1 asserts the count and that no name matches /settle|pay|capture|refund|charge/. The absence being asserted is SETTLEMENT, not the word: price_disclosure, price_basis and price_band are legitimate read-side members, and a check that fails on them is a check somebody disables.

absent.settlement: There is no settlement verb — not deferred, not permission-checked. The surface has no such operation, so no instruction can reach one. ADR-001.
